# Sense & Forum

> Sense & Forum® is Serena Gasparini's no-nonsense, community-led marketing agency: senior marketing leadership for launches, go-to-market strategy and growth marketing, built on the DELIA Model™, Serena's methodology for designing programmes, communities and growth systems.

Serena Gasparini founded Sense & Forum® and created the DELIA Model™. The agency is where that methodology gets built into real programmes, communities, marketing systems and experiences. Serena also advises independently through a separate practice at serenagasparini.com — that advisory work and Sense & Forum's agency delivery are related but distinct.

## Key pages

- [About](https://senseandforum.com/about): Sense & Forum's story, founder, values, and the DELIA Model™.
- [Services](https://senseandforum.com/services): Audit and Redesign, Fractional CMO, Growth Support and Community Management, Build From Scratch, and Launch Partner.
- [How We Work](https://senseandforum.com/how-we-work): The four-stage method — Audit and Review, Design, Implement, Prove It and Review It.
- [Our Work](https://senseandforum.com/work): Client case studies.
- [Team](https://senseandforum.com/team): Serena Gasparini's founder bio, the core and extended team, and FAQs about Serena, Sense & Forum and the DELIA Model™.
- [Contact](https://senseandforum.com/contact): Book a discovery call.

## Entities

- Serena Gasparini: Fractional CMO and Community-Led Marketing Strategist, founder of Sense & Forum®, creator of the DELIA Model™. Personal site: https://serenagasparini.com
- Sense & Forum®: the agency Serena founded, where the work is built and delivered.
- The DELIA Model™: Serena Gasparini's methodology, not a separate company.
- FemNEST: a separate venture founded by Serena Gasparini (a financial wellness platform), distinct from Sense & Forum.
